shots.prompt: Photorealistic candid photo, not a real or famous person. A young Israeli woman in her mid-twenties, dark curly hair tied up, oversized grey hoodie, sits on a worn beige fabric couch in a sunny Tel Aviv apartment living room with a laptop open on her knees (we see the back of the laptop lid, no logo). She has just turned her head sharply to her right, toward someone sitting next to her just out of frame, eyebrows shooting up, eyes wide, mouth starting to fall open in disbelief. She sits in the right third of the frame, looking toward frame left. Soft natural window light, plants and a bookshelf softly blurred behind, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, documentary handheld feel, true skin texture. Leave empty space around the edges of the frame.
shots.why: A real-looking face and a real reaction open the ad; code can't make a person.
